# Register Custom Post Type

This note is derived from the WordPress snippet set and explains the core idea behind **Register Custom Post Type**.

## Why it matters
Creating a new post type for things like 'Movies' or 'Products'.

## Example
```wordpress
function create_movie_post_type() {
    register_post_type('movies',
        array(
            'labels' => array(
                'name' => __('Movies'),
                'singular_name' => __('Movie')
            ),
            'public' => true,
            'has_archive' => true,
            'supports' => array('title', 'editor', 'thumbnail'),
            'menu_icon' => 'dashicons-video-alt3',
        )
    );
}
add_action('init', 'create_movie_post_type');
```

This note is derived from the WordPress snippet set and explains the core idea behind **Modify Main Query via Pre_get_posts**.

## Why it matters
Changing the global query before it runs.

## Example
```wordpress
function exclude_category_from_home($query) {
    if ($query->is_home() && $query->is_main_query()) {
        $query->set('cat', '-5');
    }
}
add_action('pre_get_posts', 'exclude_category_from_home');
```
